description: Baseline permissions plus sidecar/dialog access for the desktop agent runtime. core:window:default does NOT include start-dragging, which leaves data-tauri-drag-region silently inert — and with the macOS overlay title bar there is no native bar left to drag the window by, so it is granted explicitly. Scoped to the main webview (not the main window) on purpose: the preview panel adds child webviews (preview-*) that load untrusted external pages, and a window-scoped capability would also cover them. With webviews: ["main"] they inherit nothing.
